description: This Java class, FeaturesDeletedStrategy, implements a strategy to handle FeaturesDeleted events within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and defines behavior to remove all features from a ThingBuilder when such an event occurs.

classes.name: FeaturesDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing an event handling strategy that processes FeaturesDeleted events by removing all features from a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Executes the strategy upon receiving a FeaturesDeleted event, removing all features from the provided ThingBuilder.
